messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT alert - p95 latency spike observed in inference-prod-usw2 (~15:07 UTC). Paging @maria (eng-oncall) and @sam. Automated mitigation not triggered.

maria: on it, paging up. quick ask: customer visible? which routes affected?

sam: seeing p50 ~230ms, p95 jumped from ~420ms -> 1.2s since 14:58 UTC. Affected: /v1/generate (long-context workloads) and batch embeddings jobs. No 5xx surge in metrics.

jia: any infra change around 14:50? kernel/driver deploys?

sam: yes — kernel update rolled to node-pool-edge-03 at 14:49 (5.15.86 -> 5.18.12) as part of routine host patching. Canary passed earlier.

maria: ok timeline noted. Nate, can you start collecting traces from affected nodes and share span histogram?

nate: pulling traces now — here's a short span list (top slow spans):
```
span: model_infer -> p95 1.05s
span: kv_cache_fetch -> p95 180ms
span: gpu_queue_wait -> p95 320ms
span: scheduler_wait (kernel) -> p95 620ms
```

sam: scheduler_wait is interesting — perf counters from node-pool-edge-03 show runqueue_length spike and increased involuntary_context_switches. grabbing /proc/stat and perf.

jia: hypothesis list (quick):
- H1: kernel scheduling/preempt changes cause wakeup latency and tail latency for cpu-bound worker threads.
- H2: page reclaim or swapping behavior causing occasional long stalls (seen on similar kernels before).
- H3: driver/GPU queue backpressure increasing wait times.

maria: adding customer impact: prod-support says some customers report generation timeouts in long-context previews (support ticket 9231). Not widespread but high severity for a few accounts.

prod-support: confirmed — 7 active sessions timed out between 15:00-15:10, all on nodes in node-pool-edge-03. No data loss.

nate: sharing quick perf snippet (from node-pool-edge-03):
```
# sar -q
runq-sz  plist-sz   ldavg-1
10       120       3.45
# perf stat -e sched:sched_switch -a sleep 10
   5,234 context-switches
   1,102 cpu-migrations
```

sam: note: runqueue_sz ~10 sustained is high for our instance size, aligns with scheduler_wait span.

jia: short mitigation options:
- M1: drain and roll back kernel on node-pool-edge-03 to previous 5.15.86 image (slow but deterministic).
- M2: cordon + move traffic off nodes (fast, but capacity risk).
- M3: adjust affinity/cgroup to bias latency-sensitive tasks (prod) onto other nodes.

maria: do M2 immediately for affected nodes, start M1 in parallel for a safe rollback plan. Who can run cordon now?

nate: cordoning node-pool-edge-03-07 -> migrating pods. kicking evictions.

sam: starting temporary routing policy to route new sessions away from node-pool-edge-03 (LB weight 0) — will take ~30s to propagate.

ops-bot: ACTIONS logged: cordon node-pool-edge-03-07, LB reroute, start trace collection. Incident severity set to SEV2.

maria: collecting logs for RCA: need kernel traces (perf sched), dmesg, brk/slab dumps, and span traces for the period 14:45-15:15. Attach links when available.

nate: uploaded traces -> https://internal.traces/reports/4356009999/tracebundle.tar.gz (contains perf.data, span dump, dmesg.txt).

sam: quick preliminary verdict: after cordon and routing change p95 dropped back to ~450ms in 3 minutes. This strongly implicates nodes in node-pool-edge-03.

jia: next steps for RCA thread:
- Build timeline (logs + deploys).
- Correlate kernel commits with config diffs (CONFIG_PREEMPT* settings).
- Run perf sched on rollback image to compare.
- Run isolated microbench on scheduling (wakeups).

maria: assigning owners: timeline -> @sam, kernel config diff -> @jia, comparisons & perf -> @nate, customer comms -> @prod-support.

prod-support: will send interim note to affected customers: "we're investigating elevated tail latency, routing around impacted nodes; no data loss. We'll follow up with RCA."

sam: logging hypotheses in incident tracker: [H1]=likely, [H2]=possible, [H3]=low (GPU queue wait didn't track with node boundary).

maria: handing off to oncall followup team for formal RCA. Escalate to infra/bench team if perf comparisons show scheduler regressions.

ops-bot: INCIDENT update: mitigation applied (nodes cordoned, LB reroute), p95 recovering. Please continue followup in #incidents and link RCA doc when created. :white_check_mark:
